name: Human Friendly Robotics Wattson
summary: Two-robot system, a feeder and a puller, that runs conduit and pulls cable from device box to panel on data-centre building sites. The New Jersey maker also builds the Tyler flooring robot; Wattson is in pilots.

germany.statusNote: In pilots in the United States; the maker's page only offers early updates by email. No German or EU sales route, price or CE information was found.
